Les clients attendent dans la salle, à d: Guests wait in the dining room, on the right; their tickets are at the top. Take ingredients from the crates, chop them on the board (hold E), cook the patty in the pan, fries in the fryer, the topped pizza in the oven and soup in the pot, plate up and put the plate on the pass. Gauges show how the cooking is going; "!!": it is about to burn. Two kitchens move: a conveyor belt splits the first in two and carries what you put on it to the other side; on the boat, everything rocks and pushes you. Serving fast earns a tip, serving in a row a combo; hurried guests pay more. One star opens the next kitchen. With the mouse: click a tile to walk there.

Jeu de cuisine en pixel art vu de dessus: Top-down pixel-art cooking game, with the dining room and its guests alongside: nine kitchens, orders to prepare against the clock (salads, burgers, soups, fries, pizzas, strawberry cups). Chop, cook in the pan, fryer, oven or pot, plate up and send it to the pass; gauges show the cooking and warn you before it burns. Swinging doors, rush hours, hurried guests, tips and combos. Three stars per kitchen. Two moving kitchens: a conveyor belt splitting the kitchen in two, and a rocking boat.
